fusions.name: Nailed to the Spot
fusions.desc: Throws a javelin that deals 14 damage to the first enemy it meets, stuns it for 1 second and leaves it [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Closing Hedge
fusions.desc: Thrusts outward in a full circle that deals 7 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and leaves each one [Slowed] for 3 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Palisade
fusions.desc: Drives a row of shafts into the ground 5 tiles long for 8 seconds. Nothing crosses it.

fusions.name: Cornered Prey
fusions.desc: You deal 12% more damage to enemies carrying your afflictions.
